decisive_spans.text: Sinus rhythm with right bundle-branch block

response.rationale: D3 includes all the elements of D2 (bifascicular block) and also includes the PR interval, which is a key finding for cardiac conduction disease. The PR interval of 204 milliseconds is at the upper limit of normal, suggesting a conduction delay, which is encompassed by the broader diagnosis of cardiac conduction disease.
